The '''2013–14 Tahiti Ligue 1''' was the 67th season of the [[Tahiti Ligue 1]] organized by the [[Tahitian Football Federation]] since its establishment in 1948.<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/tahiti2014.html RSSSF.com]</ref>
